name: KENT Crystal Alkaline – Black
summary: KENT Crystal Plus uses multiple purification process of RO+UV+UF+ Alkaline +TDS Control to remove all dissolved impurities, bacteria and viruses while retaining essential natural minerals in water with KENT’s mineral RO™ technology and enhances the pH level of the purified water up to 9.5.
intro: The KENT Crystal Alkaline B is an advanced wall-mounted water purifier designed to provide 100% pure, safe, and healthy drinking water. It features a powerful RO + UV + UF + Alkaline + TDS Control purification process that effectively removes bacteria, viruses, dissolved impurities, heavy metals, chemicals, pesticides, arsenic, rust, and fluoride while retaining essential natural minerals. Its Alkaline Technology enriches the purified water with a pH level of up to 9.5, helping regulate the body's pH balance, reduce acidity, support immunity, and promote overall wellness. The inbuilt TDS Controller maintains the desired TDS level while preserving essential minerals for healthier and better-tasting water. With a purification capacity of up to 20 litres per hour and a generous 11-litre storage tank, the purifier ensures an uninterrupted supply of clean drinking water even during power outages. The integrated water level indicator allows users to easily monitor the available purified water. Additionally, the UV LED disinfection system inside the storage tank continuously keeps stored water free from bacterial growth. Backed by 1-year warranty and 3 years of extended free service, the KENT Crystal Alkaline B combines advanced purification technology with reliable performance for every household.
